lines.1: 「Hey, Yoppi. That twintail girl was there this morning, right?」
lines.4: 「I feel like I've seen her around after school sometimes.」
lines.5: 「That's unusual. You don't normally ask about things like that, Ellie.」
lines.6: 「...Being this close to remembering something without quite getting there is bad for my mental health.」
lines.7: 「Nao-chan is president of the drama club. She writes the scripts. She's pretty, so I think she acts too.」
lines.8: 「Oh, the drama club. Now I remember.」
lines.10: 「They practice hard, so maybe that's why you've noticed them.」
lines.11: She really does love theater, as always.
lines.12: Apparently she hates the Princess, not just me.
lines.13: Must be exhausting to live that way.
